name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.192: A subtitle the alignment finds nothing wrong with is no longer treated as a
    failure. It is kept as the best version of its language, taking index 01 upward like a
    corrected file, together with an identical copy from index 99 downward - and the download
    stops there instead of hunting further candidates, which no longer spends quota on a file
    that cannot be beaten. Only files that are actually wrong (beyond the shift limit, too few
    cues) keep going into the reserved range and keep the hunt alive.
